Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus - Mizu's Turkey
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3tVJIH4.png[/img]﻿[/center]
﻿﻿
Add-on mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkey[/url], it can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url]﻿ but this is made to match with it. 

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dIibzU8.png[/img][/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkey[/url] (and its dependancies).﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
